preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 2000.
The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 2000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(0) if n == 1 else stdout == str(1) if n == 2 else stdout == str(2)
postconditions.description: The output must be 0 for n=1, 1 for n=2, and 2 for n>=3.
